name: Closai
description: Closai turns your purchase history into a personal inventory catalog. Connect it with Claude so you and your favorite agent always know what you own - no need to explain yourself from scratch every time. Search your inventory and get recommendations on what to use, wear or buy anytime, anywhere.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Closai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Closai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.closai.io/mcp/v2. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Closai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Closai provides these MCP tools: affiliate_wishlist, affiliate_wishlist_retrieve, outfit_plans, outfit_plans_retrieve, outfit_recommender, outfit_recommender_recommend, outfits, outfits_retrieve, products, and products_retrieve.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Closai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Closai in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Closai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Closai is developed by Closai, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
